remote.text:
Remote controls

Arrows: move between tiles
OK: play the highlighted channel
Back: go back one screen
Home: leave Tony

While watching:
Up / Down: next or previous channel
OK: show the channel list
Back: return to Home

preview.text:
Live preview

Rest on a tile for about one second and it starts playing silently inside the tile. Move away and it stops.

channels.text: Channel names shown here are examples only. The real list comes from Free-TV, filtered to the countries picked on first run. Broken channels are hidden automatically.

v2notes.text:
Version 2 changes

Calmer slate background, bigger rounded tiles, more space.

Top row: wide 'Keep watching' tiles showing a live still of what's on and the programme name.

Numbered row: each channel gets a fixed number, so the family can say 'put Tony on 3'.

Tile pictures: the real app shows a live still from each channel, refreshed every few minutes, with the channel logo on top.

v3notes.text:
Version 3: cinematic

The highlighted channel's live picture fills the screen, muted, with its name large on the left.

One row of channels at the bottom, as clean white logo cards with their channel number.

Pills above the row switch between countries, Recently watched and categories.

OK on a card goes full screen.
